messages.en: Hiii
What are you doing?
The Macau concert is coming up soon~
I'll fly over on a planeee~
Last time in Macau,
I couldn't eat egg tarts,
so I practically got on the plane in tears.
This time, I'm DEFINITELY eating them!!!!!
The members have already tried them??
ㅠㅠㅠㅠㅠ
I heard mango mochi is famous too,
so I told them to save some for me.
Someone must've bought some for me… right?

messages.ko: 암튼 날 신경써주는 사람이 한명은 있겠지 하는 생각~~
messages.en: Anyway, I'm thinking there must be at least one person who cares about me~~
I'm so grateful.
I've been eating so much delicious food
while on tour,
so my body fat is celebrating.
We did music shows for Andless, you know.
We only did it for one day, and when I came back,
it felt like I'd just come back from a dream.

messages.ko: 오늘 컨셉 Ai 그런 게임캐릭터 느낌인데
messages.en: Today's concept had that AI, video-game-character kind of vibe,
but people said I looked like a nurse…
I saw that the fancam came out too,
but it didn't quite reach the vibe I was hoping for.
Still, I'm really grateful that someone filmed a fancam.
There are just so many things to be grateful for.
Wondering why I'm being so grateful? ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
After having a deep talk with the members in Jakarta,

messages.ko: 우리는 참 감사한 삶을 살고 있다 라는 생각을 나누곤
messages.en: we shared the thought that we're living such a blessed life,
and we've all been basking in the afterglow ever since.

messages.ko: Y/n와 함께할수 있는 지금도 너무 감사해
messages.en: I'm so grateful that I get to be with Y/n right now.
I hope this can last forever.
I'll work hard on my dancing tomorrow too!!!!
I'm grateful that I get to show you my dancing.
Let's each think of one thing we're grateful for
before we go to sleep.

messages.ko: 비행기가 있어서 먼 나라에도 단시간에 갈 수 있음에도 정말 감사하다
messages.en: I'm really grateful that planes let us travel to faraway countries in such a short time.
How did people used to get everywhere by walking or riding horses?
I'm grateful that airplane food is delicious.
I'm going to head off now.
See you soon in Macauuu.
Y/n, I'm grateful that you were born ❤️
Haranghae 😍😍
